_comment: Every Keeper's name and personality, in level.guards() order per floor (the overheard partner takes the last name). Personality picks the voice, the alert and body barks, and the mundane lines a Keeper mutters on patrol when Miro is close. 'huddles' are off-duty Keepers in a tight group, too absorbed to look up unless Miro walks right into them. Voice clips: <kind>_<personality>.mp3, idle_<personality>_<n>.mp3, <scene>_<n>.mp3 (tools/generate_voices.py).

serious.body: Man down. Someone is inside the walls.
idle: Shift change at the bell. Not a minute before.
Count's off by one again. I'll do it twice.

goofy.alert: Oh no. Oh no no no. HEY!
goofy.body: Buddy? Buddy, get up. This isn't funny.
idle: If I walk this loop backwards, does the shift go faster?
Who took the good spoon? It had a dent. I loved that dent.

stern.body: He's dead. Lock this floor down!
idle: Boots shined. Mouth shut. That's the job.
Nobody sits down on my watch. Nobody.

funny.alert: Well, there goes my quiet night. Stop!
funny.body: No. No jokes. Who did this?
idle: They call it a tower. I call it stairs with a grudge.
Payday's Friday. Which Friday, they won't say.

stupid.alert: Wait... are you allowed out? Hey!
stupid.body: Why's he sleeping on the... oh. Oh no.
idle: Left is... this one. Yeah. Left.
If the stairs go down, who carries them back up?

lines.text: Listen to this one. 'For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son...'
Only begotten. So he only had the one?
'...that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.' John 3:16.
Everlasting life. Up here that's just an everlasting night shift.
Hush. Somebody in this tower should still believe in something.
Then I believe the bell rings at six. Wake me when it does.
